proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the inclusion of the image in the proper-support subsheaf is inherited from the presheaf construction of the etale cohomology lemma and sheafification; conversely a section of the pushforward with support proper over the base is finite with closed image, vanishes outside it, and etale locally the etale morphism decomposes into pieces isomorphic to the base over which the support lives, so pulling the section back along the inverses gives a formal sum in the presheaf lower shriek mapping to the section, showing it is etale locally in the image (source lines 430-464)
